name: TipTop Fixes
author: byo-pop
description: Mends what the original wasted or left to chance, and changes nothing else: its look, rules, sounds and pace of play stay as they were. Each fix is a toggle; with the whole mod off the game is the original. Scores and saved games are the same as the original's.

settings.label: Blocks follow the seed
settings.help: The original seeds its random numbers a second time, from the clock, when the first block is chosen, so a seed given at the start (the site's ?seed=) changes nothing. Off: that second seeding stays.

settings.label: Timing from the updates
settings.help: The game's timers run on its own updates, 10 ms each, not on the machine's clock, so the same seed and the same moves play the same game on every run, however fast the machine is.
